intro: Keep a character intention recognizable across two languages. Compare meaning, register, names, and scene timing with a paired English and Chinese practice card, rather than treating literal translation as a finished performance.
zhintro: 让同一角色意图在两种语言中都清楚成立。使用成对的中英文练习卡，比较含义、语体、人名与场景时长；逐字翻译不是完整的角色表演。
drills: Intent before translation
Write who is speaking, to whom, and what they need. Keep these three facts identical in both versions even when sentence order changes.
Meaning units
Divide each line into action, destination, and deadline. Check both versions preserve all three before recording.
Register pair
Read one friendly and one formal version in each language. Match social distance, not the exact pitch of individual words.
Name consistency
Choose one approved pronunciation for the invented place name and repeat it in both takes. Keep a small personal pronunciation note.
Timing budget
Record each version at a comfortable pace and note its duration. If one is too long for a scene, revise the adaptation before rushing it.
Independent listener check
Ask a competent speaker of each language to describe the request and relationship. Rework any mismatch and retain the two-language pair.
zhdrills: 先定角色意图
写清谁在说、对谁说、需要什么。两种版本保留相同事实，允许调整句子顺序。
核对意义单元
把台词拆成动作、目的地和期限，录音前确认两个版本都没有遗漏。
比较语体
分别用亲切和正式语气朗读两种语言。匹配人物之间的距离，不机械复制每个词的音高。
统一名称
为虚构地名确定一个经认可的读法，在两个版本中一致使用，并留下个人发音备注。
核对时长
以舒适速度录制两种版本并记录时长。若超出场景预算，先改编文本，再考虑节奏。
独立听者核对
请熟悉各语言的听者复述请求和关系，修正不一致后保存成对版本。
sample: English: Please bring the blue folder to Luma Station before noon. Chinese: 请在中午前把蓝色文件夹送到卢玛站。Context: two colleagues coordinating a handover; urgency is practical, not threatening.
zhsample: 英文：Please bring the blue folder to Luma Station before noon. 中文：请在中午前把蓝色文件夹送到卢玛站。情境：两位同事协调交接；着急是因为时间要求，并非威胁。
review: Both listeners should identify the same object, location, deadline, and relationship. Different word counts and natural prosody are acceptable; a lost deadline or accidental change in politeness is not.
zhreview: 两位听者应复述相同物品、地点、期限和人物关系。字数和自然韵律可以不同，不能遗漏期限或无意改变礼貌程度。
limit: This routine does not certify language proficiency or provide automatic translation, accent scoring, or pronunciation recognition. Use languages you can evaluate and obtain qualified review for professional localization.
zhlimit: 这套步骤不认证语言能力，也不提供自动翻译、口音评分或发音识别。练习你能够判断的语言，专业本地化需由胜任的人员核对。

intro: Build and review a small rehearsal sequence that shows distinct performance choices. Use original scenes, clear transitions, and honest labels; the checklist prepares material for review and does not produce a mixed demo file.
zhintro: 用小型排练片段展示不同的表演选择。使用原创场景、清晰转场和真实标注；本清单帮助整理待评审材料，不会自动混音或生成样片。
drills: Choose one audience
Define a character, commercial, or narration reel before choosing scenes. Do not mix unrelated work simply to make the reel longer.
Lead with a repeatable choice
Record a short opening that fits your comfortable voice and a specific relationship. Confirm you can repeat it without forcing a sound.
Contrast the second scene
Change the objective and listener rather than only changing pitch. Compare a reassuring colleague with a suspicious gatekeeper.
Remove redundant spots
Listen to two adjacent clips without looking at their labels. Keep both only when the performances reveal different useful capabilities.
Review clean transitions
Assemble a private rehearsal version in your own editor. Check starts, endings, and level changes without using music to conceal weak dialogue.
Label and get feedback
Mark the file as a rehearsal, identify original or permitted scripts, and ask reviewers what each scene communicates before making a public reel.
zhdrills: 先定目标听者
先选角色、商业或旁白方向，再挑场景，不为延长时长而混入无关作品。
用可重复选择开场
以舒适声音和明确人物关系录短开场，确认不用强迫发声也能重复。
第二段建立对比
改变目标和听者，而不只是换音高。对比安慰同事和怀疑来访者的守门人。
删去重复片段
不看标签听相邻两段，只有展现不同有效能力时才同时保留。
检查干净转场
在自己的编辑器中拼排练版，核对开头、结尾和电平，不用音乐掩盖台词问题。
标注并征求反馈
明确这是排练样片，注明原创或获许可文本，请听者复述各段场景后再制作公开样片。
sample: Scene A: You made it. I kept the last seat for you. Scene B: The gate opens at sunrise. Until then, nobody enters. Give each scene a different listener and objective; these are original rehearsal lines.
zhsample: 场景 A：你终于来了，最后一个座位我给你留着。场景 B：大门日出才开，在那之前谁都不能进去。为两段分别设置不同听者与目标；这些是原创排练台词。
review: A reviewer should distinguish the two relationships before reading your notes. Each retained spot must be understandable on its own, repeatable, and free of a distracting edit at the boundary.
zhreview: 听者在看备注前就应区分两段关系。保留的片段要单独可理解、可重复，边界处没有干扰听感的剪辑。
limit: This is a rehearsal workflow, not professional demo production, casting representation, or a guaranteed booking strategy. Do not publish scripts or music without permission, or advertise a voice you cannot comfortably reproduce.
zhlimit: 这是排练流程，不是专业样片制作、选角代理或接单保证。未经许可不要发布文本或音乐，也不要展示无法舒适重复的声音。

intro: Explore descriptive character qualities through comfortable speech, word choice, pace, and phrasing. Compare light, steady, and playful impressions without manufacturing rasp, growls, or throat tension.
zhintro: 通过舒适说话、措辞、节奏和句式探索角色质感。比较轻巧、稳重和活泼的印象，不制造沙哑、嘶吼或喉部紧张。
drills: Neutral baseline
Read the sample in your ordinary comfortable speaking voice. Save that take so every comparison has a stable reference.
Light through phrasing
Give the greeting a brief upbeat opening and shorter phrase endings. Keep the same comfortable volume rather than adding breath leakage.
Steady through pacing
Use evenly spaced words and a deliberate final phrase. Compare whether steadiness comes across without pressing the voice downward.
Playful through emphasis
Choose one unexpected word to emphasize and keep the rest plain. Let the contrast imply character instead of tightening the throat.
Describe the listener impression
Ask a listener to select a descriptive word and quote the moment that caused it. A label without an audible example is insufficient feedback.
Return and repeat
Read the neutral baseline again. Keep only choices you can repeat easily; end the exercise if comfort changes.
zhdrills: 保存中性基准
用平时舒适的说话声音朗读示例，保存录音作为稳定参照。
用句式表现轻巧
让问候开头简短明快、句尾收得短一些，保持舒适音量，不故意增加漏气。
用节奏表现稳重
均匀安排词语，让末句从容结束，不通过压低声音制造稳重。
用重音表现活泼
选一个意外词加重，其余保持平实，用对比体现角色，不收紧喉咙。
记录听者印象
请听者选一个描述词，并指出产生印象的具体时刻；只给标签不够。
回到基准再复现
再次读中性基准，只保留容易重复的选择；舒适度改变就结束。
sample: Welcome to the night library. Your map is waiting beside the green lamp. Compare the same sentence as an ordinary welcome, a measured instruction, and a small pleasant surprise.
zhsample: 欢迎来到夜间图书馆。你的地图放在绿色台灯旁。用同一句分别表达普通欢迎、从容说明和小小惊喜。
review: Keep words and recording position constant. The listener should point to phrasing or emphasis that creates the impression, while you remain able to return to ordinary comfortable speech.
zhreview: 固定文字和录音位置。听者应指出造成印象的句式或重音，你也应能轻松回到日常说话。
limit: No rasp, vocal fry, growl, scream, or altered vocal mechanism is taught or measured here. The routine cannot diagnose vocal conditions or certify a safe specialized technique; stop at discomfort and seek appropriate qualified help for persistent problems.
zhlimit: 本页不教授或测量沙哑、气泡音、吼声、尖叫或特殊发声机制，也不诊断嗓音状况或认证技巧安全性。不适时停止，持续问题应寻求相应专业帮助。

intro: Check the recording signal path you already own before a session. Trace microphone, interface or USB input, recording application, monitoring, and a saved test file; this is a practical setup check, not a shopping list.
zhintro: 录音前检查现有设备的信号路径，依次核对麦克风、接口或 USB 输入、录音软件、监听和保存的测试文件；这是连接检查，不是采购清单。
drills: Map the signal path
Write microphone → input device → recording application → file. Identify whether your microphone connects through USB or an audio interface before changing settings.
Select the actual input
Choose the named device in your recording application. Make a short speaking test and confirm the meter responds to that microphone rather than a laptop input.
Check the required power safely
Consult the microphone and interface manuals before enabling any power option. Do not guess from a connector shape or copy another microphone setup.
Set a comfortable test level
Record ordinary and more animated lines. Inspect the application meter for clipping and revise gain before applying processing.
Monitor without a loop
Use headphones and verify the monitoring path does not feed the output back into the input. Check for echo or doubled speech in the recorded file.
Save and reopen
Export a short test to the agreed folder, close the editor, and reopen the file. Confirm that it contains the intended microphone and the full sentence.
zhdrills: 画出信号路径
写下麦克风→输入设备→录音软件→文件，先分清 USB 连接还是音频接口，再改设置。
选择真实输入
在软件里选择设备名称，说一小段并确认是目标麦克风的电平在变化，而非笔记本输入。
按说明核对供电
开启任何供电选项前阅读麦克风和接口说明，不凭插头外形或别人配置猜测。
测试舒适电平
录普通和较活跃的两种台词，检查软件电平是否削波，先调增益再考虑处理。
避免监听回路
使用耳机，确认输出不会回送输入，并回听文件是否有回声或重叠。
保存后重新打开
导出短测试到指定文件夹，关闭编辑器后重新打开，确认录到目标麦克风和完整句子。
sample: Test card: Input = my selected microphone; application = my recorder; folder = my private test folder. Spoken line: This is my setup test, followed by a quiet pause. Write the actual device names privately.
zhsample: 测试卡：输入＝已选择的麦克风；软件＝使用中的录音软件；文件夹＝个人测试目录。台词：这是我的设备测试，接下来留一段安静停顿。设备实名记在个人笔记里。
review: The reopened file must play the full line without clipping, echo, or an unintended input. A moving input meter alone does not prove that a usable file was saved.
zhreview: 重新打开的文件应有完整台词，没有削波、回声或误用输入。仅看到输入电平变化不能证明文件已正确保存。
limit: The page does not detect devices, set electrical power, record audio, or repair drivers. Hardware instructions and client requirements take precedence; no equipment purchase is required to use the checklist.
zhlimit: 网页不检测设备、控制供电、录音或修复驱动。硬件说明和客户要求优先；使用清单不需要购买设备。

zh: 远程配音录音检查清单
intro: Prepare the connection, local recording, script version, and handoff for a directed remote session. Keep the conversation channel separate from the recording deliverable and rehearse a connection failure before the appointment.
zhintro: 为远程指导录音准备连接、本地录音、脚本版本和交付。区分通话渠道与正式录音文件，并在预约前演练断线恢复。
drills: Confirm session identity
Check the time zone, contact, link, and expected connection tool in the invitation. Resolve a time-zone mismatch before the session starts.
Freeze the script version
Write the file name and revision on your private session notes. Confirm the director is looking at the same line numbers.
Test call and recording separately
Join a test call, then save a local recording. Verify both paths work; hearing you on the call does not establish that the local recorder is running.
Agree take labels
Ask how takes and pickups should be identified. Rehearse one slate and check that the label appears in the file or session log.
Rehearse a disconnect
Agree who reconnects, how the last complete take is identified, and whether local recording continues. Do not guess during a real outage.
Verify the handoff
Save the required files, reopen one, and use the agreed private delivery channel. Confirm receipt and retain the local copy according to the project agreement.
zhdrills: 核对会话身份
确认时区、联系人、链接和指定通话工具；开始前解决时区不一致。
固定脚本版本
在个人会话笔记写文件名和修订号，确认导演看到相同行号。
分别测试通话与录音
先测试通话，再保存本地录音。对方听得到你，不代表本地录音已开始。
约定 take 标注
询问 take 和补录命名方式，演练一次报号并确认文件或日志能对应。
演练断线
约定谁重连、最后完整 take 如何识别、本地录音是否继续，不在真实断线时猜。
核对交付
保存指定文件并重新打开一个，使用约定的私密交付渠道，确认收到并按项目约定保留本地副本。
sample: Fictional rehearsal: session 09:00 UTC; script Lantern v3; line 12; take 02. If the call drops after line 12, reconnect and identify whether take 02 completed before continuing.
zhsample: 虚构演练：会话 09:00 UTC；脚本 Lantern v3；第 12 行；take 02。若第 12 行后断线，重连时先确认 take 02 是否完整，再继续。
review: A successful rehearsal has matching versions, a playable local file, an unambiguous take label, and an agreed reconnect action. Neither a green call icon nor a checked box proves delivery.
zhreview: 演练通过需有一致版本、可播放本地文件、明确 take 标注和约定重连动作。通话绿灯或勾选本身不证明交付完成。
limit: This checklist does not join calls, provide a remote recording service, store credentials, or upload files. Use the tool and security requirements specified by the session organizer.
zhlimit: 清单不加入通话、提供远程录音服务、保存凭据或上传文件。使用组织者指定的工具和安全要求。

intro: Prepare a readable voice-over script with stable line IDs, separate spoken copy and directions, and a visible revision. The six checks help a performer and director discuss the same line without accidentally reading production notes aloud.
zhintro: 用稳定行号、分开的台词与指令、明确修订号整理配音脚本。六项检查帮助配音员和导演讨论同一句，避免把制作备注读成台词。
drills: Create stable line IDs
Assign one ID to each spoken unit. Keep that ID during revisions so a pickup request can still refer to the intended line.
Separate direction from speech
Put production directions in a visibly distinct label or column. Read the page once and identify exactly what should and should not be spoken.
Mark pronunciation notes
Place an approved pronunciation beside its first occurrence and in a separate note. Never silently change a proper name to make it easier.
Expose the revision
Add the project, revision, and date to the header. Give changed lines a clear marker without overwriting the previous file.
Check the actual reading view
Open the file on the screen or print layout used during recording. Check that small text, page breaks, and hidden columns do not split an important unit.
Dry-run a pickup
Ask someone to request line 02 in revision 3. Confirm you find the same spoken text and the current direction before treating the format as usable.
zhdrills: 设置稳定行号
每个台词单元分配一个编号，修订时保留，使补录请求始终指向同一句。
分开指令与台词
将制作指令放在明显独立的标签或列，通读后明确哪些字需要朗读。
标注发音
首次出现名称时附上已确认读法并另存备注，不为方便而悄悄改专名。
展示修订号
页眉写项目、版本和日期，清楚标出变化行，保留旧文件。
检查实际阅读视图
在录音时使用的屏幕或打印布局打开，确认小字、分页和隐藏列没有拆断重要单元。
演练补录定位
请他人指定第 3 版的 02 行，确认双方找到相同台词和当前指令。
sample: Lantern / revision 3 / rehearsal. ID 01 | Direction: warmly, to one visitor | Spoken: Your room is ready. ID 02 | Direction: practical, no urgency | Spoken: Please collect your key at the blue desk.
zhsample: Lantern／第 3 版／排练。01 行｜指令：温和，对一位访客｜台词：你的房间准备好了。02 行｜指令：实用说明，不急迫｜台词：请到蓝色柜台领取钥匙。
review: A reader should locate an ID without searching by sentence fragments and should never confuse a direction with spoken words. Confirm the same revision on both ends of a handoff.
zhreview: 阅读者应能按编号定位，无需搜索零碎句子；指令不能被误当台词。交接双方须确认同一修订版。
limit: This is a manual formatting guide, not a document converter or script editor. Follow the receiving studio template when supplied; IDs are organizational aids, not automatic synchronization.
zhlimit: 这是手动格式指南，不是文档转换器或脚本编辑器。若接收方提供模板，以其为准；行号只帮助组织，不自动同步。

en.heading: Screenplay V.O. or a recording sheet?
en.body: For screenplay narration, place (V.O.) with the character name and keep the spoken line in its dialogue block. A studio recording sheet instead uses stable line IDs and separate directions. Preserve the original screenplay version when preparing the recording sheet. Here is an original example of the two representations.
en.example:
Screenplay: MARA (V.O.)
The lantern waits at the east gate.

Recording sheet: L01 | MARA | narration | The lantern waits at the east gate.

zh.heading: 剧本 V.O. 标注还是录音台词表？
zh.body: 影视剧本中的画外旁白可在角色名旁标 (V.O.)，台词保留在对白块。录音台词表则使用稳定行号并分离指令。整理录音表时保留原剧本版本，以下原创例子展示同一句的两种形式。
zh.example:
剧本：MARA (V.O.)
灯笼在东门等候。

录音表：L01｜MARA｜旁白｜灯笼在东门等候。

intro: Turn a direction into a specific, testable next take. Practice clarifying an ambiguous note, repeating the agreed change, and checking the result while preserving the director’s scene objective.
zhintro: 把导演意见变成具体、可比较的下一次表演。练习澄清模糊指令、复述约定变化并核对结果，同时保留场景目标。
drills: Listen through the note
Write the exact requested change privately before responding. Separate a scene intention from a technical recording instruction.
Clarify one ambiguous word
If the note is brighter, ask whether it means reassurance, faster pacing, or a different relationship. Use one concise question rather than proposing many unrelated options.
Repeat the agreed action
State the next change in one sentence: I will keep the pace and make the invitation more welcoming. Allow correction before recording.
Change only the agreed variable
Record the same words with the confirmed choice. Do not also rewrite the line or change microphone position unless requested.
Compare the result
Play the original and revised takes with their labels. Ask which version better communicates the agreed objective, not which voice sounds prettier.
Confirm and log
Write the approved take and the direction used. Distinguish an approval from a suggestion for another attempt.
zhdrills: 听完意见
回应前在个人笔记记下具体变化，区分场景意图与录音技术要求。
澄清一个模糊词
若意见是更明亮，询问是更安心、更快，还是改变关系；用简洁问题，不堆无关选项。
复述约定动作
一句话说明下一次变化：保持速度，让邀请更亲切。录音前允许对方纠正。
只改约定变量
用同样文字录下确认的选择，不额外改台词或麦克风位置，除非被要求。
比较结果
按标号播放原版和改版，判断哪个更符合目标，不只比较声音好不好听。
确认并记录
记下获批 take 及所用指令，区分正式认可和建议再试。
sample: Director: Make “We have a place for you” brighter. Performer: Do you mean a more welcoming relationship while keeping this pace? Agreed next take: a clear invitation to one unsure newcomer.
zhsample: 导演：把“我们为你留了位置”读得更明亮。配音员：是保持速度，让关系更欢迎对方吗？约定下一次：向一位犹豫的新来者发出明确邀请。
review: The revised take should preserve words and pace while changing the agreed relationship. The final log must identify who approved which take; a friendly comment is not an approval record.
zhreview: 改版应保留文字和速度，改变约定的人物关系。记录需明确谁批准了哪个 take；友好评价不等于批准。
limit: The routine cannot interpret a real director’s intent or replace a working agreement. It provides a rehearsal conversation and local checklist; no messages are sent to anyone.
zhlimit: 本流程不能自动理解真实导演意图或替代工作约定，只提供演练对话与本地清单，不向任何人发送消息。

intro: Compare roles by scene objectives and relationships rather than surface voice novelty. Use an original two-person audio scene to prepare matching audition sides and a repeatable listening rubric for a small casting rehearsal.
zhintro: 按场景目标和关系比较角色，不只追求奇特声线。用原创双人声音场景准备一致试听片段与可重复评审标准，完成小型选角演练。
drills: Write the role needs
Define each character’s objective, listener, and practical constraints. Avoid requirements that the script cannot demonstrate.
Use the same audition side
Give every rehearsal reader the same lines and context. Keep direction and text version consistent so comparisons are fair.
Test a contrasting relationship
Read the scene once as colleagues and once as strangers. Listen for an audible change in trust rather than a cosmetic pitch shift.
Assess without seeing names
Label rehearsal files A and B for an initial listening pass. Record intelligibility, intention, and response to new information before discussing preference.
Test a callback note
Give one specific direction and record a second take. Check whether the reader can apply it while retaining the scene facts.
Review the pairing
Listen to the two roles in sequence. Verify distinct intentions, coherent responses, and consistent names before selecting a rehearsal pairing.
zhdrills: 写清角色需求
定义目标、听者和实际限制，不加入脚本无法验证的要求。
统一试听片段
给每位演练者相同台词与背景，保留同一指令和文本版本，便于公平比较。
对比人物关系
先按同事、再按陌生人读，听信任关系是否变化，而不只是音高不同。
先匿名回听
先把演练文件标 A、B，记录清晰度、意图和对新信息的反应，再讨论偏好。
试一次复试指令
给一条具体意见再录，确认能应用变化且保留场景事实。
核对角色配对
顺序播放两角色，确认意图有别、回应连贯、名称一致，再选排练组合。
sample: Keeper: The lantern is missing. Courier: I left it beside the east door. Keeper: Then someone moved it after you arrived. Context: the keeper needs the truth; the courier needs to avoid a false accusation.
zhsample: 管理员：灯笼不见了。送信人：我把它放在东门旁。管理员：那就是你到达后有人移动过。情境：管理员要弄清事实，送信人希望避免被误会。
review: The listener should track who needs what and hear the response to the new fact. Compare readers on the stated role needs; an unusual voice alone does not establish a fit.
zhreview: 听者应追踪双方诉求，并听出对新事实的反应。按事先角色需求比较，特别声线本身不证明适合。
limit: This is a casting rehearsal, not an audition marketplace or employment decision system. Obtain permission before sharing recordings and use actual production requirements for real casting.
zhlimit: 这是选角演练，不是试音平台或用工决策系统。分享录音前取得许可，真实选角以制作要求为准。

intro: Reconstruct a character performance after a break or out-of-order recording. Keep a private reference for relationship, pace, energy, and recording position so a later take belongs to the same scene.
zhintro: 在中断或乱序录音后还原角色表演。保存人物关系、节奏、能量和录音位置的个人参照，让后录的 take 属于同一场景。
drills: Make a continuity card
Note listener, objective, emotional starting point, and recording position for the sample. Use observable details rather than only the word intense.
Save the anchor take
Record the first line and a brief lead-in. Keep this reference available for a later session instead of relying on memory.
Resume after a short break
Step away briefly, replay the anchor, and record the next line. Compare phrase endings and energy before changing anything.
Record out of order
Record the last line first, then the middle line. Use the card to reconstruct the starting state of each line.
Assemble the sequence
Play the three lines in story order. Identify any sudden change in relationship, distance, or pace that the scene does not justify.
Repair one mismatch
Rerecord only the line with a documented mismatch. Compare it against both neighboring lines, then update the continuity note.
zhdrills: 建立连续性卡
记录听者、目标、情绪起点和录音位置，用可观察细节，不只写强烈。
保存锚点 take
录第一句和简短前导，保留为后续参照，不依赖记忆。
短暂停顿后续录
离开片刻，回放锚点再录下一句，先比较句尾和能量。
乱序录制
先录末句再录中句，用卡片还原每句起始状态。
按故事顺序回听
依次播放三句，找到场景没有理由解释的关系、距离或节奏突变。
修正一处失配
只重录已有记录的失配句，与前后两句比较后更新备注。
sample: Line 1: The bridge is still closed. Line 2: We can wait beside the marker. Line 3: When the signal changes, we move together. One companion reassures another; the relationship remains steady across all three lines.
zhsample: 第 1 句：桥还没开。第 2 句：我们可以在标记旁等。第 3 句：信号变化时，我们一起走。一位同伴安慰另一位，三句话的关系保持稳定。
review: In a blind playback, a listener should not detect a session break from an unexplained character or recording change. Intentional story changes should remain audible and be documented separately.
zhreview: 不看备注回听时，听者不应从无理由的角色或录音变化识别中断。有意的剧情变化应可听见并单独记录。
limit: The checklist does not automatically compare waveforms, match voices, or repair edits. It targets scene continuity; exact pickup audio specifications need a separate technical check.
zhlimit: 清单不自动比较波形、匹配声音或修复剪辑。它检查场景连续性；精确补录音频规格需另做技术核对。

zh: 配音文件交付规格清单
intro: Turn a supplied delivery brief into six verifiable file checks. Inspect format, sample rate, bit depth, channel count, processing, file names, and receipt in your own audio software; there is no universal client specification.
zhintro: 把客户交付说明拆成六项可核验检查，在自己的音频软件中核对格式、采样率、位深、声道、处理方式、命名和收件；不存在适用所有客户的统一规格。
drills: Copy the exact brief
Write the required format, sample rate, bit depth, channels, and processing policy. Mark any omitted value as a question rather than filling it from a preset.
Inspect file properties
Check the exported file, not just the recording project settings. Compare each actual property with the written brief.
Check channel content
Listen to and inspect every channel. A stereo container is not proof that two intentional channels are present.
Review processing policy
Compare the brief with the exported file for normalization, compression, noise reduction, and leading or trailing silence. Ask before applying unrequested processing.
Match naming and boundaries
Verify line or take IDs, file naming, and complete beginnings and endings. Reopen one file from the actual delivery folder.
Test delivery and receipt
Send a permitted test through the agreed private channel. Ask the receiver to open it and confirm the specification before preparing the final batch.
zhdrills: 抄录精确要求
写下格式、采样率、位深、声道和处理政策，遗漏项写为待问，不用预设补空。
检查导出文件属性
核对导出文件，而非只看工程设置，逐项对照说明。
检查声道内容
回听并查看每个声道，立体声容器不证明两个声道都有预期内容。
核对处理要求
确认归一化、压缩、降噪与首尾静音是否符合说明，未要求的处理先询问。
核对命名与边界
检查行号、take 编号、文件名和完整首尾，从真实交付目录重新打开一个文件。
测试交付与接收
通过约定私密渠道发送获许可测试，请接收方打开并确认规格后再准备最终批次。
sample: Fictional brief: WAV; 48 kHz; 24-bit; mono; unprocessed; one file per line; Lantern_L02_T03.wav. This is a worked example, not a default recommendation. An omitted loudness target remains unresolved.
zhsample: 虚构说明：WAV；48 kHz；24-bit；单声道；不处理；每行一个文件；Lantern_L02_T03.wav。这是演示，不是默认推荐。未写明的响度目标仍为待确认。
review: Every written requirement needs an actual file-property or listening result. A saved preset, filename extension, or green checklist cannot substitute for opening the delivered file.
zhreview: 每条书面要求都需有实际属性或回听结果，保存的预设、扩展名和勾选都不能替代打开交付文件。
limit: The page does not inspect, upload, encode, or certify audio files. The example values are fictional; client and platform specifications control real delivery.
zhlimit: 网页不检测、上传、编码或认证音频文件。示例数值是虚构的，实际交付按客户与平台规格执行。

intro: Check whether a listener can find your relevant samples, understand your role, and contact you. Organize an honest voice-acting portfolio with working media, permission notes, and one clear next action instead of an unexplained gallery.
zhintro: 检查听者能否找到相关样本、了解你的具体工作并联系你。用可播放媒体、许可说明和明确下一步组织真实作品集，而不是缺少说明的图库。
drills: Define the target work
Name the work you want to show: character acting, narration, or commercial reads. Choose samples that demonstrate that task.
Label your contribution
State what you performed and whether the piece is commissioned work or a personal rehearsal. Separate performance from editing or production credits.
Verify permission
Check whether each script, music bed, artwork, and client clip may be published. Leave uncertain material private until permission is resolved.
Open every media item
Test the actual public playback link on desktop and phone. Confirm it works without the viewer needing your private account.
Check contact and context
Provide a working contact path and concise relevant context. Keep private addresses and unpublished client information out of public notes.
Run a first-visitor test
Ask a listener to find one suitable sample and the contact route without instructions. Repair the point where they become lost.
zhdrills: 明确目标工作
写清展示角色、旁白还是商业朗读，选能体现该任务的样本。
标注具体贡献
说明你表演了什么、是委托作品还是个人排练，把表演和剪辑制作署名分开。
核对发布许可
分别核对文本、配乐、美术和客户片段能否公开，不确定的材料先保持私密。
打开全部媒体
在桌面和手机测试真实公开播放链接，确认听者无需使用你的私密账号。
核对联系与背景
提供有效联系路径和相关简短背景，不公开私人地址或未发布客户信息。
测试首次访问
请听者无提示找到合适样本与联系入口，修正卡住的位置。
sample: Portfolio card example: Lantern Keeper — original character rehearsal — performer: you — 25-second sample — context: a careful invitation to a traveler. Status: private review until all publication permissions are confirmed.
zhsample: 作品卡示例：灯塔管理员——原创角色排练——表演者：你——25 秒样本——情境：谨慎邀请旅行者。状态：全部公开许可确认前仅供私密评审。
review: The visitor should identify your performance, play a relevant sample, and find the contact path. Record failed links or unclear credits as incomplete even when the page looks polished.
zhreview: 访问者应辨认你的表演、播放相关样本并找到联系路径。链接失败或署名不清时，即使视觉精美也算未完成。
limit: This page does not host a portfolio, verify copyright ownership, contact clients, or promise bookings. The example is a planning card; publish only material you have permission to share.
zhlimit: 网页不托管作品集、核验版权归属、联系客户或保证接单。示例只是规划卡，公开前确认有权分享。

intro: Create a small approved pronunciation sheet for names, abbreviations, numbers, and specialist terms in a recording script. Track the source and decision so a later pickup repeats the intended reading rather than an unverified guess.
zhintro: 为脚本中的人名、缩写、数字和专门术语建立已确认读法表。记录来源与决定，让后续补录复现预期读法，而非沿用未经核验的猜测。
drills: Extract uncertain tokens
List the exact names, abbreviations, numbers, and terms that could have more than one reading. Preserve capitalization and surrounding context.
Find the responsible source
Ask the client or appropriate language specialist for the preferred reading. Separate an approved name preference from a general dictionary entry.
Record an approved reference
Save a permitted audio reference or clear written notation privately. Record the approver and revision so the choice can be traced.
Read in the sentence
Practice the term within its actual phrase. Confirm that stress and joining do not change the meaning or make the term unintelligible.
Check repeated occurrences
Read each occurrence in the script and verify the same intended name. Flag places where context changes the reading of a number or abbreviation.
Recheck before pickups
Compare the current pronunciation sheet with the latest script. Ask again when a new name or changed context is introduced.
zhdrills: 提取不确定项
逐项列出可能有多种读法的专名、缩写、数字和术语，保留大小写及上下文。
找到负责来源
询问客户或胜任的语言人员，区分名称持有者认可的读法和普通词典读音。
保存认可参照
在私密笔记保存获许可音频或明确文字记法，记录确认者与版本。
放回完整句子
在实际句子里练习，确认重音和连接没有改变含义或影响辨认。
核对重复位置
读每次出现并保持目标读法，标出上下文使数字或缩写读法变化的地方。
补录前再核对
将当前读法表与最新脚本对照，新名称或新语境出现时重新询问。
sample: Fictional pronunciation sheet: Luma = LOO-muh, approved only for this rehearsal; code A12 = letter A, number twelve; date 04/05 = unresolved until the client confirms the date convention. Read: Meet the Luma team at gate A12.
zhsample: 虚构读法表：Luma＝LOO-muh，仅用于本次演练；代码 A12＝字母 A 加数字十二；日期 04/05＝客户确认日期制式前待定。台词：在 A12 门与 Luma 团队碰面。
review: The listener should identify the correct entity and number, and the sheet should explain where each decision came from. An ambiguous date cannot pass by sounding fluent.
zhreview: 听者应辨认正确实体和数字，表格能说明每项决定的来源。日期仍有歧义时，朗读流畅也不算通过。
limit: This guide does not recognize speech or provide authoritative pronunciations for real people or brands. Its invented example is not a dictionary entry; unresolved terms require a responsible source.
zhlimit: 本指南不识别语音，也不为真实人名或品牌提供权威读法。虚构示例不是词典条目；未定术语需要负责来源确认。

zh: 配音录音房间检查清单
intro: Compare a room’s background noise and audible reflections using a repeatable test. Check your current recording position before moving furniture or buying treatment; use saved files to distinguish outside noise from room reflections.
zhintro: 用可重复测试比较房间背景噪声和可听反射。移动家具或购买处理材料前先检查现有位置，用保存的文件区分外界噪声与房间反射。
drills: Log the normal conditions
Note time, open doors or windows, and nearby appliances. Test during the conditions in which the real session will occur.
Record quiet room tone
Keep the microphone and gain fixed and save a short quiet segment. Listen for intermittent traffic, fans, or neighboring activity rather than assuming silence.
Record a fixed sentence
Use the same sample line and position for every test. Leave a short pause after it so the decay and background can be heard.
Change one placement
Move the recording position once while keeping settings consistent. Compare the two files for reflections and noise, not just louder output.
Inspect practical interruptions
Check chair noise, clothing movement, desk vibration, and notifications. Test a natural movement while listening to the resulting recording.
Retest the chosen setup
Repeat the full line and quiet segment in the selected position. Record remaining limitations and check them with the receiving engineer when needed.
zhdrills: 记录正常条件
记下时段、门窗和附近设备，在真实会话预计条件下测试。
保存安静底噪
固定麦克风和增益录短安静片段，留意间歇交通、风扇和邻居声，不假定完全安静。
朗读固定句子
所有测试使用相同台词和位置，句后留短停顿，便于听衰减和背景。
只改一个位置
保持设置移动一次录音位置，对比反射与噪声，不只比较哪个更响。
检查操作干扰
核对椅子、衣服、桌面振动和通知声，做自然动作后回听。
复测选定布置
在选定位置重录台词与安静片段，记录限制，必要时请接收工程师核对。
sample: Room test: The paper lantern rests beside the doorway. Pause, then repeat at the second position using the same input settings. File A = original position; file B = changed position; write the time and observable difference.
zhsample: 房间测试：纸灯笼放在门口旁。停顿后，在第二个位置用相同输入设置复读。文件 A＝原位置；文件 B＝改后位置；记下时间和可观察差别。
review: Choose the position where the words remain clear and unwanted sound is reduced consistently in the repeated test. A single quiet moment does not prove the room is suitable throughout a session.
zhreview: 选择在重复测试中台词清楚、干扰稳定减少的位置。某一瞬间安静不证明整场录音都适合。
limit: No room measurement, soundproofing rating, acoustic certification, or material recommendation is provided. Do not obstruct ventilation or make structural changes to complete this checklist; consult qualified help for building work.
zhlimit: 本页不提供房间测量、隔音等级、声学认证或材料推荐。不要为勾选堵住通风或改动结构，建筑工作需请合适人员处理。

intro: Prepare concise live announcements that tell an audience who needs to act, where to go, and when. Rehearse normal updates, changed information, and a correction using a fictional event instead of improvising facts over a microphone.
zhintro: 准备简洁现场广播，清楚说明谁需要行动、去哪里、何时行动。用虚构活动练习常规更新、变更和更正，不在麦克风前临时编造事实。
drills: Confirm the audience and source
Write who the message applies to and who approved its facts. Do not broadcast an unconfirmed location or time.
Put the action first
State the required action in a short sentence, then give the destination and timing. Remove background that delays the instruction.
Say locations distinctly
Read the actual room name or marker without rushing. Check whether a listener can repeat the destination after one pass.
Rehearse an update
Change one fact in the sample and label it as an update. Preserve everything that remains valid.
Make a clean correction
If you read the wrong room, explicitly correct that room and repeat the full current instruction. Avoid an unclear fragment such as actually, the other one.
Check handoff and repetition
Agree with the event lead when a message may repeat and who takes over. Save the approved wording and time in the event notes.
zhdrills: 核对听众与来源
写明消息适用人群和事实确认者，不广播未经确认地点或时间。
先说动作
短句说明要做什么，再给目的地和时间，移除拖延指令的背景。
清楚说地点
不赶着读真实房间或标记名称，确认听者一次能复述。
演练更新
只改示例一项事实，明确这是更新，保留仍有效部分。
完整更正
读错房间时明确更正并重复当前完整指令，不说含糊的另一个。
约定交接与重复
与负责人约定重复时间和接手人，将确认文字及时间保存到活动笔记。
sample: Fictional event: Workshop participants, please meet at the blue desk at 14:30. Update: The meeting point is now the green desk; the time remains 14:30. Correction: Green desk, not blue desk.
zhsample: 虚构活动：工作坊参加者，请于 14:30 在蓝色柜台集合。更新：集合点改为绿色柜台，时间仍是 14:30。更正：绿色柜台，不是蓝色柜台。
review: After a single reading, the listener must identify the intended group, current destination, and time. Compare the update against the approved facts rather than measuring excitement.
zhreview: 单次朗读后，听者需说出适用人群、当前地点和时间。更新按获批事实核对，不用兴奋程度评分。
limit: This is a normal-event rehearsal, not an emergency announcement protocol or public-address system. Real emergency communication must follow the venue’s authorized procedures; the page does not verify live event facts.
zhlimit: 这是常规活动演练，不是应急广播规程或广播系统。真实应急沟通遵循场地授权流程，网页不核验活动实时事实。

intro: Plan a bounded rehearsal around one scene objective, a baseline take, a small number of comparisons, and a review. Separate preparation, practice, and follow-up so a schedule produces observable decisions instead of an arbitrary streak.
zhintro: 围绕一个场景目标、基准 take、少量对比和回听安排有限排练。分开准备、练习和后续，让计划产生可观察决定，而不是追求连续天数。
drills: Define one outcome
Choose a result such as a clearer scene turn or consistent character relationship. Write how a listener will recognize it.
Prepare before the session
Select a short original or permitted script, set up your recorder, and identify the line to compare. Keep preparation separate from performance time.
Record the baseline
Make one comfortable unmodified take. Save it with a clear label before trying a new direction.
Reserve comparison time
Plan two versions that change one variable. Leave time to listen rather than using the whole session for repeated recording.
Use an explicit stop point
Finish after the planned comparison or earlier if comfort or attention changes. Unfinished steps can be resumed; completion is not an endurance target.
Schedule the next question
Write what worked, what remains unclear, and the next specific test. Revisit after a break with the same reference instead of starting from memory.
zhdrills: 定义一个结果
例如转折更清楚或角色关系一致，写下听者怎样辨认。
排练前准备
选短原创或获许可脚本，设置录音设备并确定比较句，把准备与表演时间分开。
录基准版本
用舒适自然声音录一版，先按明确标签保存，再试新指令。
留出比较时间
安排只改一个变量的两版，给回听留时间，不把全部时段用于反复录音。
设置停止点
完成计划对比就结束，舒适度或注意力变化时可提前停，未完步骤下次继续。
安排下一个问题
记录有效选择、未清楚事项和下一次测试，休息后用同一参照复查，不凭记忆重来。
sample: Example plan, adjustable: preparation 5 minutes; baseline 2 minutes; two contrast takes 4 minutes; playback 5 minutes; notes 2 minutes. Objective: make “The key is still inside” sound like a practical discovery, not an accusation.
zhsample: 可调整示例：准备 5 分钟；基准 2 分钟；两种对比 4 分钟；回听 5 分钟；笔记 2 分钟。目标：把“钥匙还在里面”说成实际发现，而非指责。
review: The session is useful when you retain a baseline, identify one audible difference, and write a next test. Duration and checked steps alone do not establish progress.
zhreview: 有效排练需保存基准、辨认一个可听差别并写下下一次测试。时长和勾选本身不能证明进步。
limit: The page does not provide a calendar, reminders, a personalized training prescription, or automatic improvement measurements. The example timing is optional and should fit the task and your comfort.
zhlimit: 网页不提供日历、提醒、个性化训练处方或自动进步测量。示例时长可选，应按任务和舒适程度调整。
